memory_update.text: VECO is the highest-priority US-listed underfollowed candidate for the compound semiconductor photonics tools node due to direct InP laser manufacturing tool evidence.

AXTI should remain in the Layer 1 universe as an adjacent substrate/wafer candidate, but requires verification that InP demand is specifically tied to AI/datacenter optics rather than telecom, sensing, consumer, or China-local demand.
LITE and COHR validate the downstream InP laser and AI/cloud datacenter optics demand chain but are high-attention reference anchors, not the main underfollowed discovery targets.
Need a later pass on non-US-listed or OTC names, especially Aixtron, plus Japanese and European photonics tool suppliers, because the node may be more concentrated outside primary US listings.

node: Compound semiconductor epitaxy and photonics manufacturing tools
summary: Research-only Layer 1B expansion for the compound-semiconductor photonics tool node. The strongest US-listed direct underfollowed candidate is Veeco, because official company disclosures tie its MOCVD, ion-beam deposition, and wet-processing tools to InP laser manufacturing for AI/datacenter optical interconnects. AXT is an adjacent substrate/wafer candidate: it is not a toolmaker, but its InP/GaAs substrates sit one step upstream of epitaxy and photonic devices. Lumentum and Coherent are included only as high-attention reference anchors because they validate demand for InP lasers, transceivers, and photonics platforms used in AI/cloud datacenters.
